Chorus, thus with imagined wing our swift scene flies, in motion of no less celerity
than that of thought. Suppose that you have seen the well-appointed king at Hampton Pier
embark his royalty, and his brave fleet with silken streamers the young Phoebus fanning.
Play with your fancies, and in them behold upon the hempen tackle shipboys climbing,
hear the shrill whistle which doth order give to sounds confuzzed. Behold the threatened
bottoms through the furrowed sea, breasting the lofty surge. Oh, do but think you stand
upon the riveage and behold a city on the inconstant billows dancing, for so appears
this fleet majestical, holding due course to her floor. Follow, follow.
Grapple your minds to sternage of this navy, and leave your England as dead midnight still,
guarded with grandsires, babies, and old women, either past or not a rivet to pith and pwissence.
For who is he, whose chin is but enriched with one appearing hair, that will not follow
these cold and choist-drawn cavaliers to France? Work, work your thoughts, and therein see
a siege. Behold the ordinance on their carriages, with fatal mouth-scaping on girded her floor.
Suppose the ambassador from the French comes back, tells Harry that the king doth offer
him Catherine his daughter, and with her, to dowry, some petty and unprofitable duketums.
The offer likes not, and the nimble gunner with linstock now the devilish cannon touches.
